name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna
description: The objective of the Scheme is to provide financial assistance to the Economic Backward Class who are admitted to Diploma / Degree / Postgraduate Professional courses through Centralized Admission Process (CAP).
department: Maharashtra Animal and Fishery Sciences University(MAFSU)
implementingAuthority: Maharashtra Animal and Fishery Sciences University(MAFSU)

criteria.label: ( As per the GR Dated 01st March 2018 - 07th October 2017 )

evidence.quote: ( As per the GR Dated 01st March 2018 - 07th October 2017 )

criteria.label: 1. Applicant should have Nationality of India.

evidence.quote: 1. Applicant should have Nationality of India.
2. Candidate should be Domicile of Maharashtra State.

criteria.label: 3. Applicant should be ”Bonafide Studentof Institute” and admitted for Professional and Technical course (Graduation / Post Graduation Degree) as mentioned in GR.

evidence.quote: 3. Applicant should be ”Bonafide Studentof Institute” and admitted for Professional and Technical course (Graduation / Post Graduation Degree) as mentioned in GR.

criteria.label: 4. Deemed University and Private university is not applicable.

evidence.quote: 4. Deemed University and Private university is not applicable.

criteria.label: 5. Candidate should be admitted through Centralized Admission Process (CAP).

evidence.quote: 5. Candidate should be admitted through Centralized Admission Process (CAP).

criteria.label: 6. Applicant should not avail any other scholarship/stipend.

evidence.quote: 6. Applicant should not avail any other scholarship/stipend.

criteria.label: 7. For current Academic Year, Only 2 child from family are allowed for benefit of scheme.

evidence.quote: 7. For current Academic Year, Only 2 child from family are allowed for benefit of scheme.
8. The Total Annual Income of Family / Guardian should not be more than 8 Lakhs.

criteria.label: 9. Minimum 50 % attendance in previous semester (Exception for fresh admitted in College).

evidence.quote: 9. Minimum 50 % attendance in previous semester (Exception for fresh admitted in College).

criteria.label: 10.During course duration, candidate should not have a gap of 2 years.

evidence.quote: 10.During course duration, candidate should not have a gap of 2 years.

criteria.label: 11.Candidates are eligible those who have taken an admission under general category.

evidence.quote: 11.Candidates are eligible those who have taken an admission under general category.

criteria.label: 12.Applicant should attempt every semester or annual exam.

evidence.quote: 12.Applicant should attempt every semester or annual exam.
